brief.reference: Original reference image supplied by artist
brief.art_direction: Clean approachable anime-casual, no unapproved new ornament

strengths: The signature head silhouette creates recognition
A clean upper garment balances the vivid lower-body color rhythm
baseline.proportions: Full hair mass balances relaxed shoulders and compact lower silhouette
baseline.color_front_back: Muted main large block, small controlled contrasting accents; back accessories retained
baseline.wearing_identity: Casual wearing behavior defines non-performative mood
baseline.detail_hierarchy: Keep high-signal head accessory; avoid tiny repeated stripes

candidates.mechanism: Small hue harmonization on an existing back accessory
visible_changes: Adjust two back ribbon colors to directly match clothing
candidates.cross_part_effect: Makes back palette more uniform but flattens the existing muted color contrast
candidates.appeal_gain: Potentially stronger direct color echoes but little evidence of character-specific appeal
candidates.baseline_loss: Muted contrast and natural lived-in feel are reduced
candidates.strongest_objection: Palette matching alone does not produce a more distinctive or attractive character
candidates.failure_test: At equal size the accessory looks generic or the back loses visual depth
candidates.lower_cost_alternative: Keep existing ribbon colors and compare at equal scale first
candidates.anime_impact: Same number of color cells and same draw cost
candidates.decision_reason: No distinct character appeal gain beyond matching colors

candidates.mechanism: Rebalance mid-body shape flow without extra detail
visible_changes: Adjust side seam volume to make the relaxed upper silhouette transition more clearly into lower flared skirt
Keep existing upper-garment markings and skirt accents unchanged
candidates.cross_part_effect: Creates upper-width to waist to skirt rhythm without disturbing focal head design, side view must be checked
candidates.appeal_gain: Can strengthen playful relaxed quality of the specific outfit through the torso/waist/hem relationship instead of generic fashion detailing
candidates.baseline_loss: Risk of losing the established comfortable oversized feel if waist gets too fitted
candidates.strongest_objection: The original oversized outline may already be the best articulation of comfortable character mood
candidates.failure_test: If the new waist reads tight or the upper mass loses warmth, reject this concept
candidates.lower_cost_alternative: Keep original body width and only test a gentle hem curvature; compare against B
candidates.anime_impact: No added constant linework or color cells, test folds at normal shot
candidates.decision_reason: A reversible garment-shape hypothesis can improve appeal through cross-part rhythm, with specific falsification and no extra decoration

selection_reason: B changes a character-relevant shape relationship rather than erasing design identity or adding surface marks; retains meaningful old details while exposing a falsifiable proportion tradeoff

keep: Existing face, hair, hat, colors, accessories, secondary markings
Original rendering detail level and overall relaxed mood
change: Only a subtle reshaping of upper garment side taper and hem curvature, matched across front and back
forbid: New sleeve stripes, new trim, extra layers, straps or accessories
Changing any motif or producing a design-report infographic
render_contract.output: One neutral background, consistent front and back full-body character only; report stays separate
